github.description: The most powerful and modular diffusion model GUI, api and backend with a graph/nodes interface.

releases.title: v0.35.0
releases.notes_html:
What's Changed

  • [Partner Nodes] chore(Google): drop retiring Veo 2 and Veo 3.0 models by @bigcat88 in #15883
  • [Partner Nodes] feat(Recraft): add V4 Styles by @bigcat88 in #15903
  • [Partner Nodes] feat(WAN): add WAN3-Prime model support by @bigcat88 in #15894
  • Bump comfyui-frontend-package to 1.51.9 by @comfy-pr-bot in #15696
  • Support avif in Save Image Advanced node. by @comfyanonymous in #15891
  • fix(video): remux HEVC to mp4/mov as hvc1 via hevc_mp4toannexb by @bigcat88 in #15809
  • fix(memory): respect the container cgroup memory limit instead of host RAM (CORE-394) by @bigcat88 in #15927
  • Update workflow templates to v0.11.50 by @comfyui-wiki in #15931
  • [Partner Nodes] feat(Google-Omni): add support for Omni 1.1 model by @bigcat88 in #15929
  • feat(3d): File3DToMesh node — parse GLB/GLTF/OBJ/STL into MESH by @jtydhr88 in #15919
  • Add to readme that we support HDR and high bit depth. by @comfyanonymous in #15940
  • Add cfgpp_ud10_ab sampler. by @comfyanonymous in #15951
  • MiniMax-H3: Support PDD LoRA by @kijai in #15908
  • Add section about user input tolerance to AGENTS.md by @comfyanonymous in #15955
  • [Partner Nodes] fix(HeyGen): update Avatar Video price badge by @bigcat88 in #15945
  • Improve some warning messages. by @comfyanonymous in #15977
  • feat: add VideoTrim and VideoCrop nodes with VIDEO_EDIT widget inputs by @jtydhr88 in #15637
  • Disable push event trigger for failing workflow. by @comfyanonymous in #15995
  • Add how to cache model stuff to AGENTS.md by @comfyanonymous in #16003
  • Minimax h3 controlnet as a model patch instead of a controlnet. by @comfyanonymous in #15975
  • Support SenseNova U1.5 (CORE-411) by @T8mars in #15922
  • Allow using references with MiniMax-H3 Fun Union and fix prefetch rac… by @kijai in #16020
  • Disable ck attention when fp32 + low_precision_attention False. by @comfyanonymous in #16029
  • Enable PyTorch SDPA attention and FP8 ops for gfx1170 by @tvukovic-amd in #16014
  • [Partner Nodes] feat(MiniMax): add H3 Max option to H3 text-to-video and first-last-frame nodes by @purzbeats in #16025
  • Update workflow templates to v0.11.52 by @comfyui-wiki in #16024
  • Lower trellis workflow remesh memory usage. by @comfyanonymous in #16034
  • Annotate temp paths in Preview3DAdvanced / PreviewGaussianSplat / PreviewPointCloud outputs by @jtydhr88 in #16038
  • [Partner Nodes] feat(Minimax-H3): add the Max model to the Reference node by @bigcat88 in #16041
  • Update workflow templates to v0.11.54 by @comfyui-wiki in #16045
  • Fix SAM3 segmentation head receiving 4 FPN levels when scalp=1 by @ussoewwin in #15979
  • Enable PyTorch SDPA attention and FP8 ops for gfx1171 by @tvukovic-amd in #16039
  • Add live resolution preview widget to ResolutionSelector by @jtydhr88 in #16013
  • Emit the document canvas from ImageCompositor for the layer editor by @jtydhr88 in #15742
  • Add warning about forcing single GPU mode on Windows by @comfyanonymous in #16055
  • Register partner_run_gate_enabled feature flag by @MaanilVerma in #16012
  • Update README.md by @alexisrolland in #16071
  • MiniMax-H3: Make VAE optional, allow using text encoder only references by @kijai in #16065
  • Support MiniMax-H3 and HiDream O1 loras trained with DiffSynth-Studio / ModelScope by @yjy415 in #15662
  • Update nodes to improve search rank by @alexisrolland in #16074
  • Lower peak trellis workflow vram and ram usage. by @comfyanonymous in #16054
  • Make comfyui handle missing workflow media properly. by @comfyanonymous in #16079
  • Remove some workflow media from portable install to make it smaller. by @comfyanonymous in #16080
  • [Partner Nodes] feat(Recraft): add V4 Styles Pro models to Create Style node by @bigcat88 in #16043
  • Fix Get Image Size Description by @rattus128 in #16091
  • Allow disconnected Switch inputs by @rattus128 in #16083
  • chore: Update nodes categories by @alexisrolland in #16077
  • Introduce Comfy Compiler (CORE-389) by @rattus128 in #15861
  • Remove now unecessary minimax memory workaround. by @comfyanonymous in #16103
  • [Partner Nodes] fix(Tripo): real output formats, exact pricing, missing parameters and six new nodes by @bigcat88 in #16060
  • [Partner Nodes] feat(Meta): add Muse Image nodes by @purzbeats in #16078
  • [Partner Nodes] feat(Anthropic): add Claude Fable 5.1 to the Claude node by @bigcat88 in #16085
  • [Partner Nodes] feat(MiniMax): add H3 Max Turbo option to H3 text-to-video and first-last-frame nodes by @bigcat88 in #16094
  • Update workflow templates to v0.11.55 by @comfyui-wiki in #16104
  • comfy-aimdo 0.5.2 by @rattus128 in #16108
  • [Partner Nodes] feat(Comfy-Cloud): add nodes that run curated workflows on Comfy Cloud GPUs by @deepme987 in #15935
  • [Partner Nodes] feat(OpenAI): add gpt 6 astra model and reasoning param by @bigcat88 in #16125
  • [Partner Nodes] deprecate retired models by @bigcat88 in #16121
  • Update comfy-kitchen version to 0.2.33 by @comfyanonymous in #16133
  • Fix potential mps issue of supports_fp64 called with None. by @comfyanonymous in #16136
  • Add Sparse Attention node by @kijai in #16072
  • Update embedded docs to v0.5.11 by @comfyui-wiki in #15947
  • Pause comfy compiler for long lived sparse allocations by @rattus128 in #16148
  • fix(tests): Stop folder_path_test from replacing the shared cli_args singleton by @guill in #16053
  • Fix the RGB/YUV conversion nodes on images with an alpha channel by @christian-byrne in #15632
  • Add color space conversion node. by @comfyanonymous in #16135
  • Fix Detect Edges (Canny) on images with an alpha channel by @christian-byrne in #15631
  • Don't adjust the alpha channel in the image color adjustment nodes by @christian-byrne in #15629
  • Fix Quantize Image on images with an alpha channel by @christian-byrne in #15630
  • Fix Draw Text Overlay on images with an alpha channel by @christian-byrne in #15634
  • Don't blend the alpha channel in the Blend Images node by @christian-byrne in #15625
  • Don't invert the alpha channel in the Invert Image node by @christian-byrne in #15622
  • Fix Porter-Duff blend modes with transparent layers by @tandede in #15721
  • Bump comfyui-frontend-package to 1.51.10 by @comfy-pr-bot in #16118
  • Disable int8 weight-only quantization on devices without torch._int_mm (fixes MPS crash) by @chelsealong in #16130
  • Fix registration issues by @guill in #15890
  • Fix: Verify aotriton kernels actually launch before enabling pytorch attention by @0xDELUXA in #15648
  • Remove useless code. by @comfyanonymous in #16169
  • chore: Harmonize model attention nodes by @alexisrolland in #16154
  • Add LTXV generated-keyframe nodes and Freeze Latent by @adamoster in #16040
  • Comfy Aimdo 0.5.3 + Memory compiler fixes by @rattus128 in #16180
  • feat: Pixal3D multiview model support (CORE-421) by @kijai in #16048
  • Fix quantized text encoder matmul gating and Gemma4 prefill cache by @kijai in #16185
  • Cleaner way of enabling quantized mm on text gen but not on text enc. by @comfyanonymous in #16189
  • Add LTXVAddLatentGuide for pinning a pre-encoded latent as a guide by @alexanderar in #16176
  • Fix MiniMax H3 denoise mask velocity conversion by @poorpaper in #15988
  • Only lock repo PRs after merging if they contain a CLA signature. by @comfyanonymous in #16191
  • [Partner Nodes] feat(OpenAI): add GPT Image 2.5 Flare and Sunburst models by @bigcat88 in #16190
  • chores: Update tooltips of 3D nodes (CORE-323) by @alexisrolland in #16179
  • Update workflow templates to v0.11.57 by @comfyui-wiki in #16192
  • Report the file saved by Save 3D (Advanced) as a standard 3d output item by @jtydhr88 in #16171
